title: Hunga Tonga's water vapor in Olympic swimming pools

source.name: Millan et al., 'The Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai Hydration of the Stratosphere', Geophysical Research Letters

notes: 146 million metric tons of water is about 146,000,000 cubic meters. A standard Olympic pool holds 2,500 cubic meters, so the eruption injected roughly 58,400 pools' worth of water into the stratosphere.

points.label: Water Hunga Tonga added to the sky
